about: The pages the Shop shows. Each says what it does, in the person's own goal's words when one fits, what it reads and what it needs, in its own page's words, and carries its column.json's fits. A page's buying fields stay empty until it's on sale.
foot: Paid once, updates included. Works with your own Claude plan.

pages.title: Wellbeing
pages.does: Shows your sleep, bedtime, resting heart and workouts, each against your own usual.
pages.for_goal: Counts '{goal}' for you, from your iPhone's Health data.

fits.what: swims, runs, rides, walks, workouts and nights of sleep from your iPhone's Health data

pages.reads: Your iPhone's Health export, or a file of days. Read only.
pages.needs: Your iPhone's Health export, about ten minutes with Claude walking you through it. Its morning review uses some of your Claude plan.

pages.title: Finance
pages.does: Counts your money goals for you, every morning.

fits.what: money you save or keep in cash, from your accounts or a file from your bank

pages.reads: Monarch, Robinhood, or a file from your bank. Read only.
pages.needs: Its morning review uses some of your Claude plan.

pages.title: People
pages.does: Who to reach out to this week, and why now, every morning.

fits.what: people you meet or keep in touch with, from your mail and calendar

pages.reads: Gmail and Google Calendar: who and when, never the message. Or a file you drop. Read only.
pages.needs: Its morning review uses some of your Claude plan.

pages.title: Inbox
pages.does: Says what's waiting on you in your mail and calendar, every morning.

fits.what: the replies you send to people waiting on you, from your Gmail

pages.reads: Gmail and Google Calendar: who, when and the subject, never the message. Read only. It sends nothing.
pages.needs: Its morning review uses some of your Claude plan.

pages.title: Content
pages.does: Shows what to publish next from your plan, and how each video did against your usual.
pages.for_goal: Counts '{goal}' for you, from each export you add.

fits.what: subscribers, videos and views, from your YouTube Studio export

pages.reads: A file you export from YouTube Studio. It never signs in to YouTube.
pages.needs: Its morning review uses some of your Claude plan.
